summary: Curaleaf Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 30, 2026, announcing via press release that it will report its Q2 2026 financial and operational results after market close on August 5, 2026, with a conference call and webcast to follow. This filing is a routine earnings notification, not a special-situation event. It contains no terms regarding acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. Therefore, no deal_terms are applicable. As a foreign private issuer, this equates to a standard U.S. earnings press release.
